df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check premises

print("Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999:", df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].shape[0])
print("Number of duplicate patient_id values:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check if severity 'severe' exists and is correctly spelled
df_severe = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']
print("First few rows of severe patients:")
print(df_severe.head())"}
